name: Prometheus Operator
author: Sextant
description: Prometheus Operator's ServiceMonitors, PodMonitors, Probes, PrometheusRules, Prometheuses and Alertmanagers: what a monitor selects right now and whether its ports exist, which Prometheus picks an object up, a rule's groups, and Prometheus and Alertmanager readiness; opt-in problems of monitors that select nothing and of Prometheuses and Alertmanagers not available. Read-only.
